sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Noob Diamond Pickaxe are centered around breaking through stone walls and collecting essential elements. The game features a simple yet intuitive control system, allowing players to navigate through the game world with ease. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various obstacles, including stone walls, enemies, and traps.

To break through stone walls, players can use their pickaxe to chip away at the stone. The game features a gradual damage system, where the amount of damage dealt to the wall depends on the number of hits. This system provides a sense of progression and accomplishment as players chip away at the stone.

In addition to breaking through stone walls, players must also collect essential elements. These elements are scattered throughout the game world and can be collected by interacting with them. The elements are crucial for unlocking the portal, which serves as the game's final objective.

The game features a time-based mechanic, where players must collect the elements and reach the portal before time runs out. This adds an element of tension and urgency to the game, making it more engaging and challenging.
